free_tier.stated: not stated: https://alist.jiejingfan.vip/api/public/settings returns the AList v3.45.1 site settings of 晴天网盘 and carries no allowance, quota or price field

retention.stated: No guarantee. This host refused on one sweep run and listed on another, so it flaps

egress.terms: Unmetered direct links. No CDN cache was observed

tooling: the AList v3.45.1 REST API anonymously. No working WebDAV was observed. The root listing shows eight directories of iOS sideloading content: 自签, Trollstore, IPCC, shortcuts, jailbreak tools, signing tools, shared enterprise certificates and Windows. Five root-level paths are absent from the root listing: /Apple Arcade, /天翼, /看书软件, /越狱插件 and /视频教程. The /天翼 listing is empty
chaining: Read-only. The structural point is the important one: a 139Yun-backed public AList proves that a non-Chinese reader can reach Chinese carrier pan bytes through a proxy layer with no account. The access problem is solved by the proxy and only the write problem remains

limits.value: deep subdirectory listings frequently return 500 because parent directories are stubs

identity_cost.detail: the API answers a guest session

reliability_note: Volunteer-run and small. Reads return real files and the tree is half broken: file-level get works where the path resolves and directory walks fail against stub parents

evidence.proved: code 200 with provider 139Yun, write false and 8 directories
listed entries including a 4,398,583-byte archive, so real files are reachable
a path returned code 500 'failed get dir: object not found', confirming stub directories

sweep row: api_kind alist, http 200, anon_settings yes, permission 0, 8 root entries, 4/1 mounts, provider 139Yun, 0 mounts with the write flag, fronting nginx, verdict read-only. A second run recorded this same host as no-api, which is the documented flake
the public settings endpoint answered 200 with no session and returns the AList site settings of 晴天网盘, none of which is a quota, unit or price
fs/get on /天翼 answers provider 189CloudPC for a path that the root listing omits
the root listing answers code 200 to a request with no session: eight directories, write false, provider 139Yun
a direct link to a file in the root tree answers 302 to the object-storage host hcybf06.eos-huhehaote-5.cmecloud.cn; the query string is redacted in the stored record
the settings answer serves the favicon and the logo from /d/天翼/素材/, a path under the 天翼 mount
fs/get on /Apple Arcade answers provider 139Yun for a path that the root listing omits
fs/list on /天翼 answers code 200 with no entries and provider 189CloudPC; the path header reads that the netdisk is under maintenance
evidence.quote: "content":null,"total":0,"readme":"","header":"网盘维护中...关注公众号：捷径范 开放时间另行通知","write":false,"provider":"189CloudPC"}}

evidence.proved: the site icon under /天翼/素材/ answers 302 to the object-storage host cloudcube.telecomjs.com; the query string is redacted in the stored record
fs/get on /看书软件/书源 answers provider 139Yun; /看书软件 is absent from the root listing
fs/get on /越狱插件/H5GG answers provider 139Yun; /越狱插件 is absent from the root listing
fs/get on /视频教程/Quantumult X教程 answers provider 139Yun; /视频教程 is absent from the root listing
the settings endpoint answers code 200 with no session and carries the site title and version v3.45.1; it holds no allowance, quota, unit or price field

binding_note: The read path reaches a Chinese carrier pan and that is the finding. What binds is the write gate plus a tree that is half stubs, so it is a fetch source at best.
notes: A host whose upstream is Chinese carrier netdisk storage, which makes it an existence proof for the bridge pattern: a proxy layer converts an unreachable quota into a reachable read path without transferring an account. A direct-link request answers 302 to a carrier object-storage host: cmecloud.cn for a file in the root tree, telecomjs.com for the /天翼 mount.
